# Fixtures for `vra` (VRA Core 4 record)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for the fictitious Saltmere Harbour. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/media.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `breakwater-vra.xml` | written by hand from the format's specification (craft_media.py) | CC0-1.0 |
| `artwork.vra.xml` | Written for whiff's test suite (moved from `xml/`) (a VRA Core 4 record; the museum and artist are fictitious) | CC0-1.0 |
